title: Coconut Rice
subtitle: Creamy, fragrant rice cooked in coconut milk
excerpt: Rice cooked in coconut milk with kaffir lime leaves. This is the perfect base for curries and grilled dishes across Southeast Asia.
sourceNotes: Coconut rice is eaten across Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia and beyond. It is the default accompaniment for many Southeast Asian dishes, known as khao mun in Thai and nasi lemak in Malaysia.

content.text: Do not lift the lid while the rice cooks. The steam is what makes it fluffy.
Put the rinsed rice in the saucepan with the coconut milk, milk and kaffir lime leaves.
Add a pinch of salt. Stir once.
Bring to the boil over medium heat, stirring once more.
As soon as it boils, reduce the heat to the lowest setting. Put the lid on.
Cook for 15 minutes. Do not lift the lid.
Turn off the heat. Leave to steam with the lid on for 5 minutes.
Remove the kaffir lime leaves. Fluff the rice gently with a fork and serve.

items.symptom: Rice has caught on the bottom.
items.cause: Heat was too high or coconut milk scorched.
items.fix: Use the lowest hob setting; stir once only at the start.

items.symptom: Rice is still wet and underdone.
items.cause: Too much liquid or lid was lifted.
items.fix: Replace lid and cook for 5 more minutes on very low heat.

items.cause: Not enough salt or kaffir lime leaves were not bruised.
items.fix: Season after cooking and bruise the leaves firmly next time.
